scope: Approved Steps 1-3 only: frozen-journal matched cutoff, prediction/revision localization, source-belief and factor-interaction audit.
cutoff: minimum of first IMU +120 seconds and the existing ON end marker; preserve every input line in observed order up to this arrival cutoff, with an explicit common end marker
settings: unchanged Qc, priors, source covariance scale 1, strict nominal publications, stable-ID replacements, independent 100ms clock; no central IMU factors
identity_gate: online states and trajectory must equal original captured prefixes; ON final must equal captured final if its information set is unchanged; stop on scientific identity or validity failure
diagnostics: existing read-only all-publication snapshots and copied-graph checks at indices 294,594,894,1192; never feed diagnostic solutions back
event_selection: regular 30-second checkpoints plus the largest same-time current-position correction per mode; retain the adjacent before/after graphs. No selection by ATE.
belief_comparison: exact source/from/to physical intervals, first publication and latest available at ages 1s and 2s and common cutoff; exclude age-censored rows from matched age summaries; one row per edge per age
evaluation: unchanged AP20 prism/IE-TC 1s evaluators, common timestamp mask, native ROS GLIM/Kimera and receiver online/final separately
not_authorized: new native source runs, CBS or model edits, covariance swaps, parameter sweeps, gating, weighting interventions, other sequences
reference_limits: IE-TC shares CPT7 and lacks joint relative covariance; discrepancies/whitened post-fit residuals are not calibrated NIS/NEES; source family curvature is not a percentage of trajectory influence
